rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with the provided 2AB grade and image, but it overstates certainty on ICM/TE detail and adds features not reliably assessable from a single image (e.g., no vacuoles/multinucleation, cytoplasmic granularity, compression artifact).
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometrium, cycle history, diagnosis, and sperm data with embryo quality and prognosis.
Overall logical and well-structured, with conclusions generally supported by embryo grade and patient factors; minor overprecision in probability estimates and some speculative morphology comments.

Recommendations are largely consistent with Gardner grading and standard IVF practice, including SET and avoiding ERA in a first transfer, though some suggestions (e.g., PGT-A after one failure, TESE/advanced sperm selection) are somewhat aggressive without stronger indications.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, though a few recommendations are broader than necessary for this straightforward first-cycle case.
